title: Build SearchPage with global search across resources
description:
SearchPage.tsx is a complete stub (`
Search
`). Build a global search page. **Implementation:** - Search input with debounced query (400ms) - Search across: jobs (by ID, topic), workflows (by name), packs (by name) - Use existing hooks: `useJobs({ topic: query })`, `useWorkflows()` filtered client-side, `usePacks()` filtered client-side - Display results in categorized sections: Jobs, Workflows, Packs - Each result links to its detail page - Empty state: "Start typing to search..." - No results state: "No results for X" - Integrate with Cmd+K command palette if it exists **Files:** `dashboard/src/pages/SearchPage.tsx`
definitionOfDone: Each result links to detail page

implementationPlan.description: Rewrite dashboard/src/pages/SearchPage.tsx: (1) Search input (Input component) at top with debounced query via useState + useEffect with 400ms setTimeout. (2) Three query hooks: useJobs({ search: debouncedQuery }), useWorkflows() filtered client-side by name.includes(query), usePacks() filtered client-side by name.includes(query). (3) Results in 3 categorized sections (Jobs, Workflows, Packs) each with a heading and list of clickable items. Jobs link to /jobs/:id, Workflows link to /workflows/:id, Packs link to /packs. (4) Each result row: name/id, type badge, brief context. (5) Empty state: 'Start typing to search...' when no query. No-results state: 'No results for "X"' when query but empty results. (6) Loading spinner while any query is fetching.
